title: Draz Nurakk and his images
summary: Prepare for Draz Nurakk's death to release a ring of hostile images.
overview: Prepare for Draz Nurakk's death to release a ring of hostile images.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Reserve healing and control for six simultaneous images.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The initial Draz Nurakk has a twenty-four-hour despawn timer.
Killing him immediately creates six images at fixed positions: one uses a separate template from the other five.
The death transition begins the image fight rather than ending all combat.

notes: Approval E374. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
Image template IDs are verified by spawn calls; the initial Draz Nurakk template requires database confirmation.
